```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA is a socialist feminist organization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA organizes people of all genders to fight against systems of oppression and exploitation including patriarchy, capitalism, and white supremacy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Liberal representation feminism is content with increasing the number of female faces in oppressive structures.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A few women in positions of power is not liberation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Liberation means all genders having freedom and control over their own lives and bodies through ending exploitation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA fights to build a feminism for and by the working class and all oppressed people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism specifically impacts women workers through devaluing of feminized labor, sexual violence in the workplace, unpaid housework, and the expectation of emotional labor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA fights for the democratization of domestic and care work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA fights for political and social liberation for all genders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA fights for full bodily autonomy for all.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA fights for the end of state recognition of the gender binary.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA stands in solidarity with grassroots feminist movements around the world in their fight against capitalist oppression and exploitation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
